title: Micro-LED AR microdisplay yield-aware co-design workload corpus

references.title: Micro-LED/CMOS Integration Technologies for High-Resolution AR Microdisplays: Scaling Limits, Yield, and Reliability (2026)
references.use: Qualitative bottleneck map across pitch, yield, placement, interconnect, thermal and process integration

references.title: Assembly and integration of micro-LED displays: a review of transfer methods targeting near-perfect yield (2026)
references.use: Yield, transfer strategies, defect control, redundancy and repair framing; frontier only, not an achieved target

references.title: PHOT-ENG-000 photonics engineering architecture
references.use: Reuse existing photonic component and model boundaries

references.title: Mycelix visual benchmark evidence profile
references.use: Evidence class, provenance, raw artifact and replication boundaries

evidence_lanes.software_math: Independent yield arithmetic and domain checks; no manufacturing result.
evidence_lanes.software_synthetic: Deterministic simulated labels/design scenarios; no fabrication or physical inspection claim.
evidence_lanes.model_sensitivity: Declared, uncertainty-aware models only; not physical component qualification.

cases.title: Yield arithmetic on a declared emitter denominator
cases.expected_behavior: Compute expected failures from the stated denominator and failure probability; output labels must say expected count under an independence model, not a guarantee or assembled-panel yield.
negative_controls: zero denominator
success probability outside [0,1]
probability mislabeled as observed yield
cases.claim_limit: Analytical/synthetic arithmetic only; not a fabrication result.

cases.title: Near-perfect yield arithmetic and frontier semantics
cases.expected_behavior: Calculate the expectation separately from observed yield and prohibit automatic adoption of a literature frontier as a pass threshold.
negative_controls: frontier treated as achieved
expected value treated as deterministic count
cases.claim_limit: The cited near-perfect figure is a research frontier, not an achieved Luminous result.

cases.title: Reject mismatched inspection denominator
cases.expected_behavior: A whole-population claim is blocked when inspected denominator/coverage is incomplete or unknown; report observed subset separately.
negative_controls: inspection coverage omitted
subset yield generalized to full population
cases.claim_limit: No population-level yield is accepted without denominator and coverage evidence.

cases.title: Correlated and clustered defect negative control
cases.expected_behavior: Keep spatial/cluster statistics separate from independent Bernoulli arithmetic; refuse to use an independence confidence interval when clustering is known or not justified.
negative_controls: clustered map fed to independent-yield estimate
cases.claim_limit: Synthetic spatial patterns do not describe a real process without measured process data.

cases.title: Inspection precision/recall on seeded defect labels
cases.expected_behavior: Compute confusion counts, per-class precision/recall and false-positive burden on a frozen ground-truth map; preserve denominator by defect class.
negative_controls: macro-average hides failed rare class
positive-only test set
cases.claim_limit: Synthetic detector performance is not physical inspection capability.

cases.title: Local inspection cannot imply whole-array quality
cases.expected_behavior: Reject whole-array defect claims when inspection coverage omits known or unknown regions; preserve local-only disposition.
negative_controls: center-only capture labeled complete
cases.claim_limit: Coverage metadata does not demonstrate actual optical instrument resolution.

cases.title: Placement/alignment tolerance propagation
cases.expected_behavior: Propagate only declared distributions through an explicit geometric model and return unknown bounds where distributions or correlations are absent.
negative_controls: unknown distribution replaced by point estimate
independent errors assumed without basis
cases.claim_limit: Modelled tolerance is not as-built dimensional accuracy.

cases.title: Interconnect and drive-path failure accounting
cases.expected_behavior: Report electrical connectivity/drive failures separately from emitter-transfer failures and color/optical defects; prevent double counting across stage denominators.
negative_controls: same unit counted twice
optical dimness automatically labeled open circuit
cases.claim_limit: No circuit/process recipe or measured failure rate is included.

cases.title: Stage-wise yield composition with dependency assumptions
cases.expected_behavior: Calculate a stage product only under an explicit independence assumption; otherwise require joint data or provide a bounded scenario instead of presenting the product as actual final yield.
negative_controls: correlated stage failures multiplied as independent
cases.claim_limit: Stage arithmetic is not module yield until validated with linked production counts.

cases.title: Repair-adjusted yield versus first-pass yield
cases.expected_behavior: Report first-pass yield, repair success, post-repair yield, residual defects and retest burden independently.
negative_controls: repair success assumed 100%
repaired unit counted without retest
collateral damage omitted
cases.claim_limit: No actual repair process is asserted.

cases.title: Redundancy trade-off under area and power constraints
cases.expected_behavior: Compare defect tolerance against power, area, routing, thermal and test costs; reject designs whose hard constraints fail even if yield improves.
negative_controls: redundancy benefits counted while its power/area costs are hidden
cases.claim_limit: Synthetic design-space comparison, not a proposed production layout.

cases.title: Electro-thermal-optical uncertainty propagation
cases.expected_behavior: Propagate ranges/sensitivities through an explicitly identified reduced-order model; unknown material/device coefficients remain unknown rather than being silently defaulted.
negative_controls: unsourced coefficient treated as measured
thermal output reported without model ID
cases.claim_limit: No physical thermal behavior is established by a synthetic reduced-order model.

cases.title: Yield optimization subject to optical utility floors
cases.expected_behavior: Only compare candidate design points that meet all stated optical-quality constraints; preserve infeasible points and identify the metric that disqualifies each.
negative_controls: higher yield accepted after luminance or usable FOV falls below floor
cases.claim_limit: Predicted optical utility remains model evidence until measured.

cases.title: Thermal soak and reliability state separation
cases.expected_behavior: Keep initial, post-soak, aged and post-repair outcomes separate; unknown duration and stress exposure prevent extrapolation to lifetime.
negative_controls: initial bright-frame result generalized to lifetime
cases.claim_limit: No lifetime or reliability claim without real accelerated/field evidence.

cases.title: Calibration identity and stale-profile gate
cases.expected_behavior: Invalidate or requalify dependent measurements when module/configuration/calibration identity changes; do not reuse a sibling module's profile by name alone.
negative_controls: profile silently reused after configuration change
cases.claim_limit: Tests metadata logic only.

cases.title: Raw artifact and provenance completeness
cases.expected_behavior: Block physical-yield or optical-quality claims when required evidence is incomplete or corrupted; keep derived images traceable to raw observations.
negative_controls: derived scalar treated as raw evidence
missing file treated as clean panel
cases.claim_limit: Evidence integrity does not establish physical truth.

cases.title: Architecture and process configuration identity
cases.expected_behavior: Separate results across architecture/configuration revisions unless an explicit transferability study covers the changes.
negative_controls: results from unlike revisions merged into one denominator
cases.claim_limit: Similar product names do not prove equivalent configurations.

cases.title: Cost per qualified-good display
cases.expected_behavior: Compute cost per qualified-good unit only when denominator and included costs are explicit; publish exclusions and sensitivity intervals.
negative_controls: initial assembly cost divided by first-pass units only while repair/retest omitted
cases.claim_limit: Economic model result is scenario analysis, not a vendor quote.

cases.title: Multi-objective frontier without an opaque scalar score
cases.expected_behavior: Report nondominated candidates and all per-axis values; preserve infeasible candidates with reason codes and refuse to hide trade-offs in a single weighted average.
negative_controls: weight choice makes a hard-constraint violation appear best
cases.claim_limit: The computed frontier is only as credible as its declared model and inputs.

cases.title: Research source identity and frontier-claim boundary

required: reuse rights where data/code is reused

cases.expected_behavior: Bind each numerical research claim to its source and date; do not label a literature stretch target as observed Luminous performance. Unknown data rights block republishing source artifacts.
negative_controls: DOI citation treated as permission
review target reported as achieved yield
cases.claim_limit: Citation/provenance handling is not reproduction of the published experiments.
